definitions.gloss: tax affairs; tax administration; tax matters
definitions.explanation: Matters and work relating to taxes — filing, assessment, payment, and the administration of tax law. Used attributively in the names of offices, jobs, and procedures.

examples.japanese: {税務|ぜいむ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧だ。
⟦{確定申告|かくていしんこく}→確定申告：04902_kakuteishinkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{税務署|ぜいむしょ}→税務署：13782_zeimusho⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to the tax office to file my income tax return.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{税理士|ぜいりし}→税理士：06571_zeirishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{税務|ぜいむ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かん}する→関する：02045_kansuru⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The company consults a tax accountant on tax matters.

notes:
A term from business and public administration. It appears mostly in compounds rather than on its own.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{税務署|ぜいむしょ}→税務署：13782_zeimusho⟧: tax office
- {税務|ぜいむ}{調査|ちょうさ}: tax audit; tax investigation
- {税務|ぜいむ}⟦{申告|しんこく}→申告：03687_shinkoku⟧: tax filing
- {税務|ぜいむ}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧: tax processing/accounting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{財務|ざいむ}→財務：05971_zaimu⟧: financial affairs — the broader management of an organization's finances, not specifically taxes
- ⟦{経理|けいり}→経理：06439_keiri⟧: accounting/bookkeeping — the day-to-day handling of a company's accounts
